per-(完全) + mit(送、放, 来自拉丁语mittere) -> 完全放出 -> 允许
c: Students must obtain permission from their advisor before conducting experiments in the laboratory.
学生在实验室进行实验前必须获得导师的许可。

r: per-(完全) + pend(悬挂) + -icular(形容词后缀) -> 完全悬挂着的(垂直向下) -> 垂直的
c: The architect ensured that all supporting columns were perfectly perpendicular to the foundation.
建筑师确保所有支撑柱都与地基完全垂直。
